issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Bitmap24: the template header declares a three-parameter constructor Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth) but the implementation (in the template .cpp) defines a two-parameter constructor Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height). The solution repository uses the two-parameter constructor in both header and implementation. This inconsistency in the template (header vs implementation) will cause compile-time errors and confuse students about the intended constructor signature.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template header and implementation consistent. Either (A) change template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp to declare Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height) to match the .cpp implementation, or (B) implement a matching three-parameter constructor Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth) in Bitmap24.cpp. Prefer option (A) because the solution and existing implementation expect the two-parameter constructor.
